decision_basis: plan_v5 section 1b stop condition: permissive/compatible license for exact repos, downloadable weights, free disk, smoke checkpoint; default for unclear license:other = not used

Q1.risk: published base-model GSM8K-flex pass@8 is 12.4% (3.4B) / 15.0% (9.7B) and MATH500 pass@8 0.8 / 1.0%: q_mixed>=0.2 may fail on GSM8K/MATH with G=8; Reasoning Gym sets are the main hope; seed semantics: trainer seed (see below), 1e21/1e22 replicas' recipe script not in PR 10555

Q2a.risk: 25B fp32 = 99.85 GB vs ~107-114 GB free on this machine: do not stage locally; use cluster scratch or convert shard by shard to bf16 (~50 GB)

Q2b.note: all five exist; the three smallest-D models are likely at the floor for GSM8K/MATH (3.4B base GSM8K-flex pass@1 2.0% at 1e21)

Q2c.license: license: other, no license text/name/link, no LICENSE file; SFT data nyu-dice-lab/wildchat50m-rewild-sft-385700 is license:other
Q2c.note: issue 6279 says SFT-from-base is mostly inert for math (best base-SFT MATH500 10.6 at 1e22+magpie); plan's 90 GB estimate was fp32, real bf16 total is 43.6 GB

Q3.verdict: PASS for Snowball numeric curves (n=3 arms >=40 steps incl. 5.7T at 46 steps in the domain series); Delphi D1-D4 curves available from HF training logs (100 steps each) although the W&B project is NOT publicly readable
numeric_files: 06-analysis-and-reports/report-cache/rlvr1-domain-reward-series.json (464 KB; 4,114 rows arm,step,domain,mean_reward,retained_trajectories; sync 110 steps, async 110, 5.7T 46; 18 domains)
Q3.risk: dataset has no license field and the README does not name one; use only for aggregate reward curves, cite; Delphi D1/D3 curves collapse (entropy explosion) so they are not smooth sigmoids

Q4.verdict: FAIL under the default license rule (start repo license: other, endpoints have no card and no license); technically feasible otherwise
risks: plan hyperparameters (G=16, batch 256, ~146 steps) belong to the rlvr7500/dapo17k repos, NOT to the four D-endpoints (G=8, 64 prompts/step, 100 steps, lr 1e-5, 500-prompt sets)
D1 and D3 p33m67 endpoints are from the entropy-collapsed launch batch (issue 6279 E.1: 5 of 6 math cells collapsed); -fix-101 and -stab repos are the stabilized replacements
published per-endpoint MATH-500 gains not located in issue text; they are in main_rl_evals/SCORES.md inside a 231 MB tarball (penfever/delphi-rl-scaling-laws-6279-evals), not downloaded (50 MB cap)
D4 trains on MATH-500 test set; the RL prompt parquet files are on the authors' cluster/S3, not public
